description: Brescia Mobilità Spa publishes information about bike sharing through its municipal mobility catalogue. The native distribution is specifically titled Postazioni di Bike Sharing and lists a CSV station inventory. Coverage is Brescia, with annual updating declared and a catalogue revision dated 28 November 2024. Public access is free under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. The station inventory can provide service-location inputs for active-mobility capacity-planning studies. The source does not describe real-time bicycle availability, docking capacity, trip histories or route demand, and no CSV rows were requested to infer those attributes. The metadata revision does not establish a station observation date or confirm that every station currently operates. The related Brescia parking and bus-stop resources cover other transport facilities. These catalogue entries share a publisher, but the source defines the bike-sharing stations as a distinct dataset.
